tasks.title: Review, Health and Budget in panel containers of their own
tasks.summary: Declare four panel view containers (workstreams, workstreams-review, workstreams-health, workstreams-budget) instead of one activity bar container; Workstreams keeps its five linked views and its id.
acceptance: test_vscode_files.py pins viewsContainers.panel as the four containers in order, each with its views, and no activitybar entry
make test-vscode passes with the view ids unchanged
The README describes the four panel tabs

tasks.title: A blocked launch lists its checks
tasks.summary: When a check blocks, the flow shows a read-only quick pick (step 'blocked'): one row per check with an icon, blocking first; picking a health-backed check focuses the Health view; nothing launches.
acceptance: A unit test of blockedChoices shows blocking rows first, then warnings, then passes, with their icons
The integration test's blocked Run offers one 'blocked' pick listing validate, wave and claim, says 'Run alpha is blocked by 3 checks', and launches nothing

tasks.title: Launch menus and prompts from the snapshot (closes D020)
tasks.summary: Offer each launch from the row's snapshot `launches` (contextValue `launch:<kind>`, one menu clause per kind) and take its prompt from there, appending the reason when ask is 'reason'; drop the PROMPTS table.
acceptance: test_vscode_files.py pins each launch menu to `launch:<kind>` and finds no 'Use the ws-' text in the extension's sources
Unit tests show a row offering only the kinds its snapshot lists, and none for a closed row
The integration test's Abandon launches the snapshot's prompt with the reason appended

tasks.title: Repeat-last row and one combined preset pick
tasks.summary: The target pick leads with the last full choice while every part is still offered; a fresh terminal launch asks one 'preset' pick of agent x effort x permissions combinations. The agent's own check still runs before the prompt.
acceptance: Unit tests of combos and repeatChoice cover the none level, the agentCommand row, and a stale last choice giving no repeat row
The integration test's second terminal launch asks only ['target'] before the prompt and runs the same argv as the first
A fresh terminal launch asks ['target', 'preset'] (plus 'checks' only when one warns)

tasks.title: Prove it in VS Code by hand
tasks.summary: Install the vsix, open a wheel-built sample, run the end-to-end checks with the owner, and record them in 0019 and the README.

acceptance.text: The owner saw four panel tabs, a blocked Run listing its checks, a repeated terminal launch in two picks, a fresh one through the combined pick, and Abandon carrying its reason

scope.rule: Native VS Code views only, every fact from the ws CLI and every write from ws act.
